verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts explicitly support calling webhooks in addition to notifications/tickets/integrations (sentry-docs-21), and Sentry provides an official MCP server and AI-agent tooling (Autofix, Seer) that could act as or trigger remediation agents (sentry-docs-2, sentry-docs-5, sentry-docs-30, sentry-docs-34). This directly satisfies the ask of routing alerts to webhooks for automated remediation/agents. Missing for 10: a concrete documented example of webhook payload triggering a third-party automation/agent end-to-end, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
